stories.title: Distance Field Contract for Chat Messages
stories.description: Define frontend contract for consuming distance data in provider results (e.g., distance_miles, distance_text) within chat message payloads to ensure consistent rendering.
stories.evidence: GAP: Distance field not explicitly defined in frontend message schema; MessageBubble.tsx consumes generic markdown

stories.title: Distance Formatting Logic
stories.description: Implement client-side logic to format raw distance values (e.g., miles, rounding rules, fallback text) for display consistency in chat responses.

stories.title: Render Distance in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Update MessageBubble component to display distance alongside provider entries within chat messages, ensuring alignment with existing markdown rendering and styling.

stories.title: Backend Integration for Distance Display
stories.description: Integrate frontend rendering with backend-provided distance values from MAINT-DIST to ensure distances are passed through chat responses and correctly surfaced in UI.

stories.title: Distance Display Testing
stories.description: Create unit and UI tests to validate correct rendering of distance values, formatting rules, and fallback behavior when distance is missing.
